call_points.text: Portfolio split: Core brands to grow at 1-2X GDP, Growth at 2-4X GDP, Pioneer categories to reach ₹100 Cr revenue in 3 years.
E-commerce and quick commerce is described as Pidilite's fastest-growing channel over the last five years.
International footprint spans Africa, West Asia and South Asia, with South-East Asia under evaluation.
Electronics and mobility adhesives are being explored with industry partners, using Pidilite's R&D; no size or timeline given.
Deck gives no FY27 revenue, volume or margin guidance, leaving the May call's 20-24% margin corridor as the last stated target.
call_points.versus_prior: no new guidance; prior call's 20-24% margin corridor stands

call_points.text: EBITDA margin corridor of 20-24% maintained, but FY27 likely at lower end due to raw material inflation.
Two price hikes taken: 4-5% in April and 7-8% in early May at company level.
Large West India plant for premium white glue and Fevicol to be commissioned in Q1FY27.
Exports disrupted in March by West Asia conflict; exports are small for Pidilite overall.
Management warns of demand compression in FY27 if inflation persists; Q1 momentum may hold.
Nina waterproofing declined 16% in Q4 due to environmental restrictions on construction workfronts.

guidance.statement: Capex to remain at 3-5% of revenue
Aim to raise UVG by about 100 bps over FY26's 11.1%
EBITDA margin corridor retained at 20-24%; could be middle to higher end if crude stays in the mid-80s
Endeavour to deliver double-digit underlying volume growth, inching up over time

industry: Commodities > Chemicals > Chemicals & Petrochemicals > Specialty Chemicals

operating_notes.text: Received CGST penalty order of ₹0.80 Cr for the period July 1, 2017 to March 31, 2018.
VAM was under 10% of FY26 raw material consumption; Q4 VAM price was about $840 a tonne, now around $1,800.
FY26 UVG was 11.1%, about 100-120 bps higher than the previous year.
Nina waterproofing declined 16% in Q4 due to environmental restrictions on construction workfronts.
Investor deck puts the Roff tile and stone solutions market at ₹~6,500 Cr with category penetration of 20-25%.
Deck states ₹3,300+ Cr capex over 10 years, ~70 manufacturing units and 50+ distribution centres.
Emerging India reach covers ~40,000 towns/villages, ~3.8 lakh dealers and 24,000+ Pidilite Ki Duniya outlets.
VAM consumption averaged $1,370 in Q1FY27 versus $924 a year ago and about $800 in Q4FY26.
Consumer & Bazaar underlying volume growth was 12.2% and B2B 7.3% in Q1FY27; B2B exports UVG was -8.4%.
Tile adhesive penetration in India is not more than 25-30%, per management.

predictions.kpi: Standalone EBITDA margin within guided band

timeline.summary: On April 20, 2026, Pidilite Industries informed the exchange that it received a CGST penalty order of ₹0.80 Cr for FY18.
Madhukar B. Parekh, on behalf of Promoters, declared no encumbrance on Pidilite Industries shares during FY2025-26.
On April 29, 2026, Pidilite Industries announced that its subsidiary PVPL agreed to transfer its stake in Buildnext to JSW One Platforms in a share swap and invest up to ₹22 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,583.38 Cr (+14.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹579.27 Cr.
On May 7, 2026, Pidilite Industries reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,572 Cr (+14.1% YoY) and PAT of ₹584 Cr (+36.6% YoY).

On May 15, 2026, Pidilite Industries filed the transcript of its May 8 Q4/FY26 earnings call, where management maintained its 20-24% EBITDA margin guidance amid 40-50% raw material inflation and guided FY26 capex at about ₹570 Cr.
On May 22, 2026, Pidilite filed an investor presentation recapping its brand portfolio, ₹3,300+ Cr of capex over 10 years and ~70 plants, with no new FY27 guidance.
On May 26, 2026, Pidilite Industries informed the exchange about receiving a GST penalty order of ₹15.19 lakh for FY 2021-22.
Pidilite Industries Limited schedules Q2FY27 earnings call on October 29, 2026, at 3:30 PM with Sudhanshu Vats, Kavinder Singh, Sandeep Batra, Amit Agarwal, Bhavesh Joshi.
